scenes.text: Close your eyes for a second and try to imagine your favorite song playing, but think about whether you actually hear the lyrics like a radio in your mind, or if you just silently know the words exist.

Believe it or not, scientists have discovered that nearly ten percent of the population lives in absolute cognitive silence, a rare phenomenon known as anendophasia where people completely lack an inner monologue.

While you might constantly debate your daily choices in a clear, spoken voice inside your head, these individuals think purely in abstract concepts, raw feelings, and visual images without a single spoken word.
It completely changes how they solve problems and process emotions, so tell me in the comments if you actually hear a literal voice speaking inside your head or if it is completely silent.
